label: High concurrency for pipelines
click: Workspace settings > Data Engineering/Science > Spark settings > High concurrency > For pipeline running multiple notebooks: On
why: pl_<id> notebooks share one Spark session by session tag: faster runs, less capacity.

label: High concurrency for notebooks
click: Workspace settings > Data Engineering/Science > Spark settings > High concurrency > For notebooks: On
why: Notebooks opened for review can share a running session instead of starting one each.
